$comment: Gzip bytes. Budgets sit 2% above the sizes at the time they were set; lower them as bundles shrink (bun scripts/perf/bundle.ts --update). A budget that rises needs a "why" on its entry, such as { "gzip": 290000, "why": "..." }; bun run perf:guards checks it. Targets are Plan 15 goals and are not enforced yet.

entry.why: Personal sidebar organization: Pinned Spaces, the person's groups with their menus and focus, the Worktable header menu, and saving the arrangement in the background. Files, behind the files preview: file rows in the sidebar, Home and pins show a type icon by name, the New menu offers Upload File, and file rows offer move, rename, archive and delete with their uses; the file page and upload code load only when used. Namespace build of 7f5d1404 measured 284.8 KB gzip; allow 0.4 more KB. Home and Space Home are rebuilt around the latest work (#485). Space Home's page moved out of the Space layout into its own chunk, which only a Space's own page loads, and the old Recent and Temporary lists and Home's Space filter are gone. A local build of the change measured 261.1 KB gzip, under the previous budget; the budget falls to that plus 0.4 KB for build-id variation. Skill libraries, behind the preview agent tools: the Library's sidebar link, its place in the breadcrumb trail and the page menu, and its route, whose loader reads the Library's address and opens a skill's Doc as a Doc's own link does; the Library's pages and the skill editor load only when opened. A Mac build of 00f81ffc measured 262.7 KB gzip; allow 0.4 more KB. Help, behind Preview (#507): every page carries the thin help wrappers, which render nothing outside Preview and load the tips, their words and Next Steps only where help is on; the welcome's host and the tips' Worktable mark; Next Steps' icons, which join the shared icon file; and the dialog code split out for the welcome, which loads only when it opens. CI build of e476f003 measured 264.1 KB gzip against main; allow 0.4 more KB. Codex shows its own app mark: the agent logo table gains one entry, 11 bytes gzip in the entry (CI build of b27f8475 against main 7cc9eb08, which sits at this budget); allow 0.2 KB for build-id variation. Threads archive when quiet (#535): the Threads routes read which list to show (the archive or not) from the URL before their screen loads, the list request says whether it wants archived threads, and the reconnect check uses the archive rule to keep an archived thread that is still open. CI build of 9b65d2c4 measured 264.7 KB gzip against 264.5 on main, before the archive rule's roughly 0.2 KB; allow 0.6 more KB on top of main's 264.7 KB budget. QR codes for share links (#555): the QR Code icon joins the shared icon file every page loads; the code, its encoder and its panel load only when someone opens a code. A CI-runner build of 27b2290 measured 265.5 KB gzip against 265.3 KB for main e9d5f58d with the same build id (181 bytes more); allow 0.2 KB for build-id variation. Office file types: the file-type table, which every page loads, learns decks (pptx and its relatives) and the other Word and Excel relatives, and the sidebar icon set gains a presentation icon. CI build of d3b04fbb measured 265.9 KB gzip; allow 0.4 more KB. Search over the page (#556): the shell owns the Cmd/Ctrl+K and slash shortcut and the header's search button, so search opens from every page before the sidebar has loaded, and on a phone. A CI build of ab2fcd29 merged with main measured 0.4 KB gzip more than main; the budget rises by that. Minor and patch updates of 23 Nov (#604): @base-ui/react 1.9 (+7.6 KB raw in the entry), tailwind-merge 3.7, floating-ui and sonner grow the entry by 4.5 KB gzip, measured against main in CI build run 45139567186 (main 266.4 KB, now 270.9 KB) and attributed by package from sourcemaps of both builds; React stays on 19.2. Allow 0.4 more KB. The sidebar for large Spaces: folders newest first with their first rows and See All, temporary docs marked in place, Records as one row with a switcher on the table, Show Archived, opening the sidebar to whatever opens from elsewhere, and the list of a folder beside the page, which travels in the sidebar's code so it adds no file. A Microsandbox build of fb5cfbfa measured 272.7 KB gzip against main's 270.9 KB; allow 0.4 more KB.

root css.why: The theme defines eight recognition colors and slate, each with solid, ink, soft and glyph values in light and dark; glyph draws sidebar Space icons without a chip. Docs share one reading stylesheet (document-content.css), which the saved preview needs before the app's JavaScript loads so nothing moves when a Doc opens. It replaces markdown.css and the preview overrides, and adds lists, checklists, code headers, tables, toggles, diagrams and the text color palette; controls that only appear once a Doc is interactive load with the viewer and editor instead. Setup and Getting Started add the connect rows, guide cards and progress ring. Worktable logos and people's photos add the tile and avatar image outlines and the picker's crop and preview styles. CI build of d0fb6356 measured 39.6 KB gzip; allow 0.2 more KB. The glyph values and a light-mode value for the open thread pane add about 0.1 KB; CI run 42151901744 on 1d8a358 measured 39.9 KB gzip; allow 0.2 more KB. Home and Space Home lay themselves out by the room they have (#485): container rules for the two-column page, the cards, rows and tiles, and the tracker's five fills. A local build measured 40.8 KB gzip, 0.7 KB more; allow 0.4 KB. Help, behind Preview (#507): the help surface, its band and icon tiles, shared by tips, help icons, the welcome and Next Steps. CI build of e476f003 measured 41.8 KB gzip; allow 0.2 more KB. Next Steps as one row of tinted step tiles (#534): the tile's light and dark fills and the row's snapping and widths. CI build of 296cdea2 measured 42.1 KB gzip; allow 0.2 more KB. QR codes for share links (#555): the code panel's full screen view and its square tile add their style rules. A CI-runner build of 27b2290 measured 42.2 KB gzip against 42.1 KB for main e9d5f58d with the same build id (150 bytes more); allow 0.2 KB for build-id variation. The table grid in Records' style (#580): its stripes, hover fills, sticky gutter overlays, column letters band and resize handle. CI run 44807670991 on d0ecabef measured 42.7 KB gzip; allow 0.2 more KB.
